entries.title: II Chronicles 27:1
segments: ¶Jotham [was] twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother's name [was] Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:2
segments: And he did [what was] right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah had done (although he did not enter the temple of the LORD). But still the people acted corruptly.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:3
segments: He built the Upper Gate of the house of the LORD, and he built extensively on the wall of Ophel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:4
segments: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:5
segments: He also fought with the king of the Ammonites and defeated them. And the people of Ammon gave him in that year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand kors of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. The people of Ammon paid this to him in the second and third years also.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:6
segments: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:7
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, indeed they [are] written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:8
segments: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Chronicles 27:9
segments: So Jotham rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David. Then Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
